answer: The cheapest real defence: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because sable only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, summit is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any ripple approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
